description.value: The Wanakena Motel is a family-owned property set on country acreage in Burns Lake, at the heart of the Lakes District in northern British Columbia along the Yellowhead Highway. It offers 17 ground-floor rooms with kitchenettes, a large parking lot, and outdoor electrical plugins. The surrounding region features over 300 lakes and is a hub for fishing, canoeing, hiking, and other outdoor recreation.
